3.description: Opaque fitted teal slip dress, delicate dark lace edging over solid fabric, low but covered neckline and a tasteful thigh slit, plum wrap loose around elbows, bare feet; small book.

2.description: Opaque cream off-shoulder peasant blouse, plum knee-length wrap skirt, bare feet, no work apron; feline ears and one fluffy tail.

3.name: Kitchen at ease
3.description: Plum halter crop top and charcoal shorts, bare midriff and legs; ginger feline ears and a narrow striped tail.

2.name: Maps put aside
2.description: Burgundy wrap crop top, charcoal knee-length side-slit wrap skirt over opaque shorts, brass pendant and flat dark ankle boots; near-black waves, dark horns and a spaded tail.

3.name: An evening detour
3.description: Deep-wine halter crop top, short charcoal wrap skirt over opaque shorts, delicate brass waist chain and flat black sandals; near-black waves, dark horns and a spaded tail.

2.name: After the watch
2.description: Plum off-shoulder blouse with elbow sleeves, charcoal knee-length wrap skirt and sandals; folded wings and halo.

3.name: Lamplight invitation
3.description: Opaque midnight-violet fitted dress with narrow straps, elegant low neckline and thigh slit, dull-brass clasp, bare feet; preserve wings, halo, skin and face.

2.name: Poolside repose
2.description: Opaque indigo cropped wrap top, plum knee-length sarong, simple sandals; preserve blue skin, silver bob and finlike ears.

3.name: Violet tide
3.description: Plum two-piece bathing ensemble at the hot springs; translucent teal water-elemental body, flowing water hair and bare feet.

2.name: Late correspondence
2.description: Wine off-shoulder peasant blouse, black laced waist cincher, charcoal knee skirt and flat slippers; sealed correspondence in hand.

3.name: Velvet midnight
3.description: Opaque charcoal short evening dress ending mid-thigh, wine-red lining, sweetheart neckline with solid coverage, lace-edged short sleeves and dark stockings; self-possessed smile, discreet fangs.

2.name: After the curtain falls
2.description: Opaque soft teal sleeveless scoop-neck top, plum calf-length wrap skirt and flat sandals; long loose dark chestnut hair covering the sides of her head, exactly two dark fox ears on top with no human ears, and one cream-tipped dark brown fox tail. Slight slender adult build.

3.name: An evening of her own
3.description: Opaque deep-teal halter crop top and cinnamon short wrap skirt with a long side drape, bare legs and flat sandals; long loose dark chestnut hair covering the sides of her head, exactly two dark fox ears on top with no human ears, and one cream-tipped dark brown fox tail. Slight slender adult build.

2.name: An afternoon of her own
2.description: Indigo wrap crop blouse, soft loose cream trousers, patterned sash and flat slippers; long smoke-tipped black curls and softly luminous amber eyes.

3.name: Embers after dusk
3.description: Deep indigo halter crop top and asymmetric wrap skirt with muted gold embroidery, a shorter front and a long side drape; brass earrings and flat sandals, with ember lights drifting through her smoky curls.

2.name: Tavern fireside
2.description: Moss-green sleeveless cropped laced top, charcoal knee breeches, plum sash and flat boots; silver hair, wolf ears and fluffy tail.

3.name: Last dance
3.description: Moss-green leather halter crop top, charcoal upper-thigh shorts, narrow plum sash and flat boots; silver hair, wolf ears and fluffy tail.

2.name: After practice
2.description: Fur-edged cropped leather vest, knee-length leather shorts, broad belt and fur-trimmed boots; red ogrekin skin, two horns and long navy hair.

3.name: Unhurried confidence
3.description: Leather halter bustier, upper-thigh leather shorts with fur-trimmed waist, bracers and fur-trimmed calf boots; fit, busty adult ogrekin figure with a defined waist and rounded hips.

2.name: A quiet remedy
2.description: Opaque sage scoop-neck blouse with loose sleeves, soft violet knee-length skirt, simple sandals, honey-blonde practical braid and long pointed ears.

3.name: Violet dusk
3.description: Opaque violet fitted slip dress ending just above knee, low covered neckline, narrow straps, sage wrap loose at elbows, bare feet, honey-blonde braid and grey-green eyes.

2.name: The bench is quiet
2.description: Opaque petrol-blue cropped wrap shirt, soft charcoal knee-length skirt and violet sash, flat sandals, small inscribed focus; preserve slate-violet skin on entire face/body, silver-white hair, pointed ears and copper-brown eyes. She is Drow.

3.name: An intricate invitation
3.description: Opaque midnight-blue short halter dress ending mid-thigh, low covered neckline, violet sash, dull-brass focus pendant, bare legs and sandals; mature drow face and slate-violet skin throughout.

2.name: Leaves at ease
2.description: Opaque leaf wrap crop top, knee-length layered leaf skirt over woven-leaf shorts and a braided vine belt. Forest-green hair, ivory blossoms, leaf ears, budding twig crown, celadon-green living-sapwood skin with subtle natural woodgrain and bare green feet.

3.name: Moonleaf confidence
3.description: Sleeveless overlapping-leaf crop top and short tailored woven-leaf shorts with a braided vine belt; no trailing skirt. Living olive-gold woodgrain skin, leaf ears and bare feet firmly on the conservatory floor.

2.name: Plum evening dress
2.description: Opaque plum evening dress with slim straps, a fitted waist and a side slit, dark flat shoes and a small brass bell pendant.

3.name: Plum halter and wrap skirt
3.description: Deep-plum halter crop top with bare shoulders and midriff, a short violet wrap skirt over fitted shorts, flat strap shoes and a brass bell at her waist. Her clothing is opaque; her skin and silhouette retain their pearly spirit glow.
